seo_title: AI for Psychologists: 24/7 Clinical Support Assistant
seo_desc: Bridge the weekly gap in therapy. We implement clinical AI assistants that support patients and detect risks in real-time.
author_pitch: As an AI specialist engineer, I know technology can save lives when applied ethically and with precision. I have designed systems that allow therapists to be present without being connected, transforming mental health into a continuous, safe, and highly profitable service.
title: Ending the weekly gap: Clinical AI for total therapeutic support
body:
Does your patient feel lonely and unprotected in the abyss that separates one session from the next?

The major problem with traditional therapy is the lack of support between consultations. The patient leaves motivated on Monday, but the crisis appears on Wednesday night and you don't see them again until the following week. This void causes relapses, slows down recovery, and limits your income to exchanging hours for money. Without real data on what happens in your patient's daily life, you are working blindly based only on what they remember in the session, losing a critical intervention window for their health.

The trap of Generic Self-Help Chatbots

Many professionals try to recommend generic apps that do not respect the therapist's psychological approach or offer real clinical safety, causing a disconnection between the patient and the treatment. A bot that gives empty advice without professional supervision is not therapy; it is a latent health risk.

Our solution: Therapeutic Extension AI Clinical Assistant

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we develop an intelligent support system specifically trained under your approach (CBT, Humanistic, or Psychoanalysis). It is a digital clone of your methodology that lives on the patient's device to record, support, and alert.

  1. Active Voice Emotional Diary: The AI initiates interaction by asking about the mood; the patient responds via voice, and the system transcribes and analyzes the sentiment for your clinical record.
  2. Real-Time Risk Detection: Advanced algorithms identify risk keywords (self-harm or severe crises), immediately alerting the professional and activating containment protocols.
  3. Private Doctrinal Training: We train the AI with your own materials and focus so that the language and suggested exercises are an exact extension of your face-to-face sessions.
  4. Secure Omnichannel (WhatsApp/Telegram/private chat): We deploy the assistant in the apps the patient already uses, guaranteeing data encryption and the absolute privacy required in the Healthcare sector.

The Real Impact on the Healthcare Sector

  • Therapy Plus Subscription Model: You stop depending on the billable hour to create total support plans, moving from charging €60 per session to premium subscriptions of €250/month per patient.
  • Radical Improvement of the Therapeutic Alliance: The patient perceives constant support, which increases treatment adherence and accelerates measurable clinical results.
  • Professional Scalability: You can manage more cases with greater security, as the AI performs triage and daily data collection, allowing you to focus only on strategic intervention.
